description: Change a monitor's own settings. Each monitor takes only its sections (get_check lists them as editable.sections): checkout (checkout monitors), devices (flow and page monitors), errorScan, brokenLinks, accessibilityPages (accessibility), uptime (the URL, text that must / must not appear, accepted statuses, timeout, alert after N minutes, maintenance windows, an API endpoint's method / body / JSON rules), aiOutput, browseUrl (storefront), shopUrl / productUrl (prices), dkimSelectors (email authentication), structurePages (structure drift), webVitalsDevices (Core Web Vitals). Every address must be a full URL on the site's own domain. A section you pass replaces that section; the rest stays. Turning it on or off and its schedule: update_check. The visual monitor: update_visual_monitor.

accessibilityPages.description: Accessibility: extra pages to test on top of the key pages (full URLs on the site, up to 20). A new page's issues are reviewed on its first scan, not failed

aiOutput.description: The site's own AI feature: its endpoint (full URL on the site), a fixed prompt, and what the answer must (not) contain

brokenLinks.description: Extra pages to crawl, address fragments to skip, and whether external links are checked too

browseUrl.description: Storefront: the shop page (blank = the calibrated one)

depth.description: "ready" stops at the payment step; "order" places a REAL test order (the WordPress plugin marks it, keeps it out of stock, analytics and ad platforms, and removes it)

expect.description: What the order totals must be

fieldAnswers.description: Answers for checkout fields Relvato can't fill by itself: match = the field's label or name, value = what to enter

productUrl.description: The product to buy (full URL on the site; blank = Relvato picks one)

verifyEmail.description: Order mode: confirm the order email arrives

dkimSelectors.description: Email authentication: your mail provider's DKIM selectors (up to 10)

errorScan.description: Extra pages to scan (full URLs on the site) and error texts to ignore

uptime.description: Uptime: what the probes check and when they alert. The whole section is replaced: fields left out go back to their defaults (except maintenance, kept unless sent)

absentText.description: Down if the page contains this text

alertAfterMin.description: Minutes down before alerting (0-60, default 0 = as soon as both regions confirm)

body.description: POST only: the request body (sent as JSON when it parses as JSON; up to 2,000 characters). No custom headers or secrets

expectText.description: Down if the page doesn't contain this text

json.description: Rules on a JSON answer (up to 10; down when any fails): the value at `path` ("status", "checks.db.ok", "items[0].id") tested with `op` against `value`

path.description: Dot path into the JSON answer

value.description: What to compare with (a number for lt / gt; not needed for exists / missing)

maintenance.description: Maintenance windows (up to 10): no uptime alerts and no Uptime run inside them, and an outage that starts inside one counts as downtime only after it ends. Left out = keep the saved windows; [] clears them. A new one-off window can't start in the past

from.description: once: start, ISO 8601 with a time zone

to.description: once: end, ISO 8601 (at most 7 days after the start)

tz.description: weekly: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Bucharest

maxResponseMs.description: The monitor's run warns above this response time (500-30000, default 8000); not counted as down

method.description: API endpoints: the request method (default GET)

okStatuses.description: Accepted status codes, e.g. "200-299, 301" (blank = any non-error answer)

timeoutSec.description: Down if there's no answer within this many seconds (5-30, default 15)

url.description: Page to check (full URL on the site; blank = the homepage)

webVitalsDevices.description: Core Web Vitals: devices to measure

name: update_check_settings
title: Change a monitor's settings
